*Here is a non-exhaustive log of some of my bakes:*  


## Birthday Cakes

Everyone knows that making something is much more fun when you're making it for someone else!  
<br><br>

::: {#fig-louise-cake layout-ncol=2}

![](IMG_8569.JPG){group="gallery"}  

![](IMG_8583.JPG){group="gallery"}  


For my friend Louise: a three-layer chocolate cake with chocolate milk cake soak, strawberry jam, and chocolate French buttercream. I'm decidedly converted to French buttercream, or more generally any buttercream but American!

:::

<br><br><br>

::: {#fig-jp-cake}

{{< video JP_cake.mp4 fig-align = "center" >}}
